biomes.name: MOURNING FEN
biomes.subtitle: Eastern wetland · pump crews · falling water
biomes.description: East of Vesper, reed beds and black pools filter the city's runoff. Pump families live on wages paid by the concession draining their drinking water. A slower pump means fewer poisoned nests and fewer paid shifts.

biomes.name: CINDERWOOD
biomes.subtitle: Western canopy · cutting crews · ashfall
biomes.description: West of the furnaces, charred trunks shelter the last living canopy. A restoration fund pays cutters by the stump and counts its plantations before they germinate. The workers know; their children still need heat.

biomes.name: GLASSROOT STEPPE
biomes.subtitle: Northern grassland · ceramic kilns · mineral seam
biomes.description: North of the city, silver grasses root in the mineral seam used to fire Lattice bodies. Mining buys another person's continuity by removing the soil that holds a settlement together. The wind recognizes neither deed nor refuge.

biomes.name: BRINE BLOOM
biomes.subtitle: Southern salt pans · sealed cultures · abandoned homes
biomes.description: South of the floodgate, fungal fans spread over the abandoned salt pans. The growth is alive, invasive, and indifferent. Licensed cultures and feral descendants drink from the same dwindling seep; neither can be persuaded to leave enough.

landmarks.name: Lantern kitchen tally
landmarks.evidence: Fourteen bowls went uncollected yesterday. The kitchen still counted them as meals supplied. Beside each bowl, Nella has written the name of someone who could no longer afford water.

landmarks.name: Commons water meter
landmarks.evidence: The meter records one household debit and one kitchen debit for every donated jug. The same serial numbers appear in both columns. The concession labels the second payment a charitable handling charge.

landmarks.name: Open pantry ledger
landmarks.evidence: The proposed rota assigns purchasing, cooking, washing, and an open weekly count to different households. Donations cannot be billed back to their donors. The water allotment itself remains unchanged.

landmarks.name: Unsorted witness shelf
landmarks.evidence: A sealed request asks to preserve a morning spent repairing a coat with a sister. Its index says commercially insignificant. The witness has not consented to deletion.

landmarks.name: Cooling priority console
landmarks.evidence: The cooling queue sorts by outstanding payments, then by resale eligibility. Consent is recorded in a column the scheduling routine never reads. Three premium cabinets hold redundant copies.

landmarks.name: Glass Steps consent desk
landmarks.evidence: The amended rota asks each witness which copies can be released. Cold storage is allocated to irreplaceable records first. It cannot preserve every copy; no clerk may choose a deletion for someone else.

landmarks.name: Occupied flats register
landmarks.evidence: Twenty-three occupied flats are listed as vacant overflow. Their residents have written indoor temperatures beside the official zero population. The former concession office receives heat continuously.

landmarks.name: Copper heat diverter
landmarks.evidence: The valve can share the office feed between occupied risers. Its default repair form makes the named technician personally liable for eleven years of deferred maintenance.

landmarks.name: Copper Walk shift charter
landmarks.evidence: The charter rotates heat between risers, caps working hours, and records the inherited repair liability as contested. No relief worker signs as the sole debtor.

landmarks.name: Court warning log
landmarks.evidence: The last flood advisory reached the advertising amplifier. The amplifier was disconnected by unanimous request. No visual or tactile endpoint acknowledged the warning.

landmarks.name: Tactile warning relay
landmarks.evidence: The test circuit pairs an amber lamp sequence with pulses through the handrail. A separate steady light marks a failed circuit. The prototype draws power from the court battery.

landmarks.name: Listening Courts noticeboard
landmarks.evidence: The inspection rota names two neighbors per shift and a manual warning route if the battery fails. The lights and handrail stay public; private rooms keep control of their own speakers.

landmarks.name: Night platform register
landmarks.evidence: Forty service-pass holders signed the last departure sheet: cleaners, carers, couriers, and a lift mechanic. The public timetable records no paying passengers and recommends closure.

landmarks.name: Service-pass counter
landmarks.evidence: The occupancy counter excludes service passes before counting passengers. A maintenance concession supplies those passes as part of wages. Travel is simultaneously compensation and statistically nonexistent.

landmarks.name: Last Connection duty board
landmarks.evidence: The revised rota staffs the late lift and retains fewer, published connections. Service passes count toward demand. A named relief crew inherits each shift, and missed departures must be recorded.
